name: OrcaCon
blurb: Seattle-area tabletop gaming convention near Sea-Tac Airport with a CATAN National Championship Qualifier; paused for 2027, planning to return in 2028.
notes: On hiatus: the site's dedicated update page (orcacon.org/orcacon-2027-show-update/) states the board decided to 'take a break from hosting OrcaCon in 2027' due to volunteer/board burnout and personal hardships, and plans to 'return in 2028' possibly at a new venue/dates. No organizing entity name beyond 'OrcaCon' (run by a volunteer board) was found. Last confirmed edition: Jan 9-11, 2026 at the DoubleTree Sea-Tac (per homepage text 'January 9th-11th, DoubleTree Sea-Tac, Washington State'); that edition's guest list (20 tabletop designers/streamers incl. Cody Pondsmith, Chris Pramas, Stefan Pokorny) was captured in pipeline/cache/extract/orcacon.guests.json but is not included here since it predates the research window.
